clientsExcluded: The Immich mobile apps (iOS and Android) and their automatic photo/video backup behaviour
The browser-based Immich web client served to each user's device
Device or vendor cloud backups configured within those client apps

evidence.claim: The MOS package bakes an immich-config.json into the server image and points IMMICH_CONFIG_FILE at it, setting newVersionCheck.enabled to false so the enabled-by-default release check is turned off.

Immich's new-version check is a supported system setting (newVersionCheck.enabled) that is enabled by default and can be disabled through the IMMICH_CONFIG_FILE configuration file rather than only the admin UI.

Only immich-server is published through the generated app route; immich-postgres, immich-valkey, and immich-machine-learning are internal-only services, and the first admin account is created locally in the Immich web UI without any upstream Immich account.

The photo and video library, database, thumbnail cache, and machine learning model cache persist to package-owned volumes, and DISABLE_MACHINE_LEARNING=false runs a local machine-learning service so facial recognition and smart-search inference execute on the MOS server.

Machine learning models (CLIP for smart search and InsightFace for facial recognition) are downloaded from the immich-app organisation on Hugging Face on first use into the local model cache; inference then runs locally, and the photos themselves are not sent to an external service for processing.
evidence.source: Immich FAQ and machine learning documentation

evidence.claim: The web map view loads its map style and tiles from Immich's own hosted tile service at tiles.immich.cloud by default; this is a browser-side request made only when a user opens the map, and it is configurable through the map style settings.

telemetryControls.claim: MOS disables the enabled-by-default new-version check through the upstream-supported IMMICH_CONFIG_FILE mechanism (newVersionCheck.enabled=false) baked into the server image, so the server issues no scheduled release-check requests to GitHub.

openQuestions: No runtime network capture was performed against the pinned v3.0.2 images; conclusions rely on package configuration and upstream documentation rather than observed traffic, so residual outbound requests were not independently ruled out.

Machine learning features download models from Hugging Face on first use and the web map view loads tiles from tiles.immich.cloud; these optional external touchpoints remain unless an operator disables machine learning or overrides the map style, and this review does not disable them.
The Immich mobile and web clients, and any device or vendor cloud backups configured within them, are outside the reviewed server package boundary.
